verdict.rationale: Zep exposes an MCP server so MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) can interact with agent memory via natural-language chat, which provides some natural-language operability, but the product itself is primarily an API/SDK plus a zepctl CLI for administration—there's no evidence of a native natural-language command interface for operating Zep's core functions (creating threads, managing graphs, governance) directly. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language command support within zepctl or the API/dashboard itself, first-party docs describing NL command parsing, independent confirmation of NL usage beyond MCP chat clients.
